result.name: Delivery Partner Financial Transparency Portal
result.business_requirement: The business requires the platform to provide Delivery Partners with direct, secure access to their historical earnings summaries, payout schedules, and tax documents within the application interface.
result.business_objective: This requirement supports the business goal of ensuring gig-economy worker financial compliance and trust, distinct from internal platform audit logging.
result.business_value: Meeting this need reduces administrative friction for workers managing personal finances and mitigates reputational risk associated with tax non-compliance; failure to provide this harms worker retention and regulatory standing.
success_measures: 100% of active Delivery Partners can access earnings data within 30 seconds of login
Zero critical security incidents related to financial data exposure
Proposed 20% reduction in customer support tickets regarding payment queries
policies_and_constraints: Access to financial data must be restricted to authenticated Delivery Partners only.
All financial document downloads must be encrypted and logged for audit purposes.
Data retention for historical earnings must comply with local labor and tax laws.
assumptions: The Payment Provider can supply standardized earnings and tax data feeds.
Delivery Partners have consistent mobile device access to the application.
Existing authentication systems support secure access to sensitive financial modules.
risks_and_dependencies: Dependency on Payment Provider API stability for real-time data accuracy.
Potential regulatory changes affecting tax document formats or retention periods.
Risk of data leakage if role-based access controls (FR-016) are not strictly enforced.

findings.finding: Assumption that the Payment Provider can supply standardized earnings and tax data feeds is not verified.
findings.evidence: Evidence gap: The Discovery Business Context mentions 'Financial settlement' and 'Payment Provider' as stakeholders but does not confirm the existence or standardization of data feeds from external payment providers.
findings.recommendation: Verify the data integration capabilities and standardization of the specific Payment Provider(s) intended for use to ensure the assumption holds.

semantic.assessment_summary: BR-008 addresses a critical need for gig-worker compliance and trust. The requirement is well-defined with clear business value. The main gap is the unverified assumption regarding the data feed capabilities of the Payment Provider, which is a key dependency for fulfilling this requirement.
